description.value:
Prerequisite: 18+ Cursed Energy score

You have learned how to invade the barriers of others without breaking them. You gain the following benefits:

  • While outside a barrier, you can make a Cursed Energy check as an action against the CE save DC of the sorcerer who created the barrier to invade it. On a success, you can enter the barrier although the creator will know a creature has entered.

  • While inside a barrier, as an action you can make a Cursed Energy check against the CE save DC of the sorcerer to alter its properties. On a success, you can change the creatures allowed to enter or leave or other properties of the barrier.

jjk5e.automationNotes: 2.23: the activity picks the nearest physical barrier. From outside, the GM rolls the CE check against the creator's CE save DC and grants one entry; the creator is told. From inside, choose the change first; on a success the GM applies it.
